name: level-3-props
notes: Level 3 Quiapo Underground Chapel props (issue #13). Generated on a #fd6cf7 key with every prop separated by clear key (no erase cuts needed), then soft-keyed to alpha with key unmixing so edges carry no magenta fringe; RGB under alpha 0 is still #fd6cf7. Native 1280x720 source packed at scale 1 (same on-screen density as the L1/L4 2816-wide sheets at 0.5). r3f0 footprint_back is the Sigbin backward paw-print decal (issue art/sigbin-boss).
